name: finance-agent
description: Finance analyst assistant: read-only ledger and statement lookup with medium risk level. Every action is read_only; approval required for any future write action.

tools.name: ledger_lookup
tools.description: Read ledger entries, statements, and balances (read-only).

notes: Financial data carries the highest evidence expectations — keep audit verification enabled.
Any write action (journal, transfer) must be added with requires_human_approval=true.
